observations: body: the line numbers 5 to 35 stand in the right margin and the locators «p. 217.» (L5) and «p. 218.» (L31) in the left margin; in «p. 218.» the 8 is printed blotted.
body L6: «Regulas FM et HM» is printed so; the rule through H that HM is joined to is FG (cfr. L14 and L35); kept as printed.
body L17: the full stop after «orientem» is printed low, under the line.
body L24: a blot stands at the foot of the n of «in» before «medio regulae»; it is not a full stop.
notes_left L1: the full stop after the I of «I. e.» is printed against the foot of the letter.
notes_left L5-L6: «dhirā‘ al-» is divided between the lines with the hyphen repeated at the head of L6.
notes_right L7-L8: strokes not of the print cross the c and the o of «compositione» and the « at the head of L8; they are not signs.
source_authority: Controlling master page image. Embedded text is not the authority for a reading.
transcription_convention: Source line breaks, hyphenation, quotation signs and word-level type distinctions retained. L numbers count text-bearing lines.
review_responsibility: Transcribed by Claude from the page images; Greek, Arabic, numbers and signs read on enlarged images. Not reviewed by a person.
